propositions: resolve_hierarchy_link currently uses type-tier comparability (epic=2, story=1, task/bug=0) which prevents direct dependencies between tickets of different types under the same parent

a blocking link whose resolved endpoints are ancestor-descendant must be rejected as redundant, but the current redundancy check uses the original pair before promotion, allowing invalid ancestor-blocking edges to be written
blocking link resolution should escalate endpoints to direct children of their nearest common ancestor instead of promoting by type tier
parentless tickets should be treated as siblings under a virtual root sentinel so all endpoint pairs have a defined common ancestor
_get_ancestors is capped at max_hops=2 which truncates chains deeper than epic-story-task and feeds a fallback that produced bug 1803
non-blocking relations (relates_to, duplicates, supersedes, discovered_from, caused_by) must retain original-pair redundancy semantics and gain no new rejections from the blocking-branch widening
